purpose: Deterministic per-channel rendering and dispatch policy for governed outbound drafts. A draft that violates any hard rule here can never reach DRAFT_READY. 渠道适配是确定性代码门禁，不是 agent 自由发挥。

value_packet_binding.rule: Every draft must reference a frozen ValueHypothesisPacket and list the evidence claim ids backing its FACT sentence. Renderer may compress language but may not upgrade epistemic status (hypothesis stays conditional, external proof stays possibility).

unresolved_placeholder_rule: Any remaining {{...}} token in subject or body blocks DRAFT_READY.

forbidden_patterns.reason: numeric outcome promise transplanted to target account
external case proof presented as target-account certainty

forbidden_patterns.reason: 中文承诺型 ROI 禁止

forbidden_patterns.reason: account intent asserted as personal intent
bulk-spam register destroys deliverability and trust

compliance.hard_rule: No consent evidence => WhatsApp draft can never reach DRAFT_READY, regardless of score.

timezone_rule: Recipient local timezone must come from the evidence ledger (office location claim). UNKNOWN timezone blocks scheduling; it never defaults to sender timezone.

persona_channel_priority.whatsapp_positioning: WhatsApp is a continuation channel (post trade-show contact, referral, or explicit consent), common in SEA/LATAM/MEA trade contexts; it is never a cold first-touch channel in this policy.

cross_channel_consistency: The same ValueHypothesisPacket feeds all channels for one person; channel drafts differ in length/register only. Contradictory value claims across channels for the same person are a hard fail.
escalation: Any hard-rule violation blocks DRAFT_READY and emits a repair reason; violations are eval evidence, not silent fixes.
